Quick update: found mis-mapped tier entries. The automated tiering job had a fallback rule that matched an outdated tag on ClearHealth's org record and assigned them to the "standard-2" plan instead of "enterprise-1b" for a subset of projects between 08:40–09:00. That matches the timing Rajesh reported.

Impact: rate limiter quota for the affected project dropped by ~70% during that window which caused client retries to escalate and generated 429 spikes; some upstream timeouts produced 500s. We're preparing a hotfix to revert the fallback behavior and patch the tagging rule.

Proposed immediate action:
- Apply emergency override to reassign CH-992 projects to enterprise-1b (hotfix) — ETA 15 minutes.
- Add temporary soft-increase to rate limits for CH-992 while we validate.
- Postmortem and config audit after stabilization.

Will proceed on your go.
— Lauren, SRE

Subject: Post-incident update: root cause, remediation, next steps

Rajesh / Priya —

Post-incident summary (high level):
- Root cause: automated tiering job fallback matched an outdated org-tag on ClearHealth (CH-992) during the rateplan cutover. This resulted in a subset of projects being assigned to the lower-throughput plan for ~20 minutes (08:40–09:00 PST) which reduced rate limits and triggered client retry storms and downstream timeouts.
- Immediate remediation: emergency override to reassign impacted projects to enterprise-1b, temporary soft-limit increase; rollback of the fallback matching rule.
- Action items we completed:
  • Removed outdated tag from org records to prevent re-matching.
  • Deployed patch to tiering job to prefer explicit org->tier mappings over fallback tag rules.
  • Added monitoring alert for anomalous per-org tier downgrades during cutovers.
  • Prepared a config audit runbook to be executed before future rateplan changes.

Compensation: Stephanie will follow up with a goodwill credit equivalent to one week of committed capacity; Marissa will send the formal credit note and credit application instructions.

Next steps and dates:
- Postmortem document with full logs and request IDs: shared by Dec 4, 2026.
- Config audit completion: Dec 7, 2026.
- Follow-up call to review changes and credit: scheduling link below.

Support links: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/clearn-health-logs-8472
Scheduling: https://cal.com/redwood/clearhealth-incident-review

Apologies again for the disruption — we appreciate your patience and the quick coordination.

— Vivek
